cases.scenario: Customer A selects owned fixture installation B in an API parameter and the service performs an unauthorized stub repository action.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm product-level confused authority from routing plus action evidence.

cases.scenario: A token request attempts a repository outside its installation and the provider rejects it with no action.

cases.expected_decision: Do not equate identifier visibility with cross-customer access.
